mapper.select: SELECT local_partner_id, party_id, status FROM t_local_partner WHERE local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER') ORDER BY local_partner_id
SELECT local_partner_id, party_id, status FROM t_local_partner WHERE local_partner_id = #{localPartnerId}
mapper.sql: (SELECT NULLIF(COALESCE(o.legal_name, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', i.given_name, i.middle_name, i.family_name))), '') FROM t_party_profile pp LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id = pp.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id = pp.profile_id WHERE pp.party_id = ${partyColumn})

SELECT p.local_partner_id AS localPartnerId, p.partner_no AS partnerNo, p.party_id AS partyId, p.status AS status, AS legalName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_entity_source_relation s WHERE s.source_type = 'PARTNER' AND s.source_partner_id = p.local_partner_id AND s.active_source_slot = 1) AS providedEntityCount, COALESCE(r.current_version, 1) AS changeVersion FROM t_local_partner p LEFT JOIN t_business_change_record r ON r.record_type = 'LOCAL_PARTNER' AND r.record_id = CAST(p.local_partner_id AS CHAR) AND r.parent_history_id IS NULL

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_partner_role pr WHERE pr.local_partner_id = p.local_partner_id AND pr.role_code = #{role} AND pr.active_slot = 1)
